item.title: PEN America, Advocate for 'Free Expression,' Withdraws Defense of Israeli Comedian Who Refused To Condemn Jewish State
item.description: PEN America, a self-described "free expression" advocacy group, withdrew its defense of the free speech rights of an Israeli comedian, Guy Hochman, whose New York City show was canceled after protesters blocked the entrance to the performance venue. item.title: Columbia Professors Arrested For Blocking Traffic to Protest ICE
item.description: Two Columbia University professors were arrested for blocking traffic for nearly an hour during an anti-ICE protest outside the Ivy League school's main gates on Thursday. One was a guard for the illegal anti-Israel encampment in April 2024. The post Columbia Professors Arrested For Blocking Traffic to Protest ICE appeared first on .

item.title: America Needs a New START? Our Enemies Never Stopped.
item.description: To the shock, horror, and dismay of onlookers around the world, the New START treaty expired on Thursday. U.N. secretary-general António Guterres called it "a grave moment for international peace and security" and lamented that, "for the first time in more than half a century, we face a world without any binding limits on the [American and Russian] strategic nuclear arsenals."
